title: IR-Runbook-Brute-Force
summary: Original short-response guidance for password guessing and suspected account compromise.
content:
## 1.1 [Immediate] Protect the targeted account
Apply a temporary sign-in block or risk-based challenge when brute-force attempts are active, and preserve authentication logs before changing the account.

## 2.1 [Investigate] Distinguish guessing from successful compromise
Review failed and successful sign-ins, source addresses, MFA outcomes, and activity after authentication. Identify other accounts targeted from the same sources.

## 3.1 [Recover] Reset credentials and revoke sessions
Reset credentials for confirmed exposed accounts, revoke active sessions, verify MFA methods, and remove unauthorized forwarding or access rules.
